Legal information

Cookie Policy

A clear record of the cookies and similar technologies used by this care-centre website.

Last updated: 22 October 2026
On this pageCurrent useNecessary technologyExternal websitesBrowser controls
01

Current use of cookies

This website does not currently use analytics, advertising, or personalisation cookies. It does not use tracking pixels or behavioural profiling.

Current statusNo optional tracking cookies

Because no optional cookies are used, this website does not currently display a cookie-consent banner.

02

Strictly necessary technology

The website host and security services may use technical storage or cookies that are essential to deliver the website, prevent abuse, or control access. These technologies cannot be used by this website for advertising.

While this website remains in private preview, its access provider may use an authentication cookie after an authorised user signs in. This is necessary to maintain the secure session. The public website will not require that sign-in unless access controls remain enabled.

Names and durations of strictly necessary cookies may change when the hosting or security service is updated.

03

External websites

This website contains links to the main Global Smile Care website and other external services. A separate website may use its own cookies after you follow a link. Its own cookie and privacy information applies there.

The font used on this website is stored locally with the site. Opening a page does not contact Google Fonts.

04

Managing browser storage

You can inspect, block, or remove cookies through your browser’s privacy settings. Blocking a strictly necessary authentication cookie may prevent access to a private version of the website.

If optional analytics or marketing technology is added later, this policy will be updated and consent will be requested before that technology is used where required.

05

Questions

For questions about this policy, contact Global Smile Care at info@globalsmilecare.be or +32 3 216 03 08.

For more about personal information, read the Privacy Policy.
